name: garmin-connect-personal-api-mcp
description: Unofficial, self-hosted MCP server for the Garmin Connect Personal API, running on Cloudflare Workers.

scripts.check: npm run types:check && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test

GARMIN_API_KEY.description: Garmin Connect Personal API key. Create it in Garmin Connect on the web under **Personal API Key**. It is shown only once and expires (30 days – 1 year).

OWNER_PASSPHRASE.description: Passphrase you enter once when adding the connector in Claude. Generate a strong one with `openssl rand -base64 32` and keep it in a password manager.

COOKIE_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Random secret that signs the login form's CSRF cookie. Generate with `openssl rand -base64 32`.

OAUTH_KV.description: KV namespace for OAuth clients, grants and tokens.

GARMIN_KV.description: KV namespace for the cached Garmin access token and small caches.
